question.text: The maximum value of <math><mi>p</mi></math> for which the lines <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi></math> constitute the sides of a rhombus is

solution.text:
If the parallelogram is a rhombus, the distance between the pair of parallel sides are equal
Hence, 12-232+42=±p-7122+52⇒p-7=±26

⇒p=33 or -19

So the maximum value of p is 33
